definitionZh: * Checkmark CSS 伪元素瞄准当前选择的可自定义选择元素中设置的选项元素中的检查标记。 它可用于提供选择哪个选项的视觉指示.
sourceDefinition: The ::checkmark CSS pseudo-element targets the checkmark placed inside the currently-selected option element of a customizable select element. It can be used to provide a visual indication of which option is selected.
